title: Canonical degree-zero cohomology cocone on inverse-image opens
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{op}\to Sch$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $c$ any cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give abelian etale sheaves $F_i$ and inverse-image transition maps $\varphi_f$ satisfying the canonical identity and composition laws [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Give a diagram $G$ of abelian sheaves on $c.pt$ with identifications $eG_i:G_i\cong (c.\pi_i)^*F_i$ and arrows conjugate to inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be ANY cocone of $G$. For a scheme $X$, an index $i_0$, a morphism $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$, and an open $W$ of $X$, put $J=I_{\ge i_0}$, $W_j=(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}(W)$ and $W_L=(c.\pi_{i_0};g_0)^{-1}(W)$. For $f:j\to k$ let $a_f:W_k\to W_j$ be the restricted transition. Define its coefficient map by inverse-image composition across $a_f;W_j.\iota=W_k.\iota;D(f^{op})$, followed by restriction of $\varphi_f$. Define $m_f$ as pullback on $H^0$ followed by $H^0$ of this map [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Similarly define $\kappa_j$ using the restricted projection $W_L\to W_j$ and the coefficient map $eG_j^{-1};L_j$. Then there exist $K:J\to Ab$, isomorphisms $eK_j:K_j\cong H^0(W_j,F_j|_{W_j})$, and $\iota:K\to const(H^0(W_L,L.pt|_{W_L}))$ such that $K(f)=eK_j;m_f;eK_k^{-1}$ and $\iota_j=eK_j;\kappa_j$. This asserts functor and cocone naturality only; it requires neither a limiting scheme cone nor a sheaf colimit. The definitions and the proved commuting-square identity in the Lean module implement the displayed arrows.

proof.text: Construct the diagram of inverse-image opens and restrict the coefficients. The identity and composition laws follow by inverse-image identity and composition coherence applied to the supplied laws.
Restrict and reindex the diagram G and its cocone L. Identify the pullbacks using the commuting projection squares; coefficient naturality gives the arrow formula.

Apply the canonical cohomology-diagram construction to this restricted system in degree zero. Transport the coefficient identification of the cocone point; its arrows and legs are the explicitly constructed square coefficients.

theorem etale_limit_open_cohomology_cocone
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) :
    let BW := AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj L.pt) 0)
    ∃ (K : Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (eK : ∀ j : Set.Ici i₀, K.obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ W j).ι).obj (F j.val)) 0)),
      (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : j ⟶ k), K.map f =
        (eK j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMap D g₀ W F φ f ≫ (eK k).inv) ∧
      ∃ (ι : K ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj BW),
        ∀ j, ι.app j = (eK j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLeg D c g₀ W F G eG L j
